articles.summary: Oshkosh Corporation (NYSE: OSK) welcomed Secretary of War Pete Hegseth as part of the Secretary’s nationwide “Arsenal of Freedom” tour.
articles.title: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth Visits Oshkosh Corporation, Highlighting the Strength of American Manufacturing and the Arsenal of Freedom

articles.summary: Oshkosh Corporation (NYSE: OSK), a global industrial technology company that develops purpose-built vehicles, equipment and services, today announced a strategic equity investment in Nextera Robotics, an artificial intelligence (AI) and robotics company developing autonomous technologies for construction project management and job site intelligence.
articles.title: Oshkosh Corporation Advances Job Site of the Future Vision with Strategic Equity Investment in Nextera Robotics
